title: Bytes Converter (B, KB, MB, GB, TB)
metaDescription: Convert raw computer bytes to bits, KB, MB, GB, TB, and PB across binary and decimal computer standards.
directAnswer: A byte is the fundamental digital unit of data storage composed of 8 bits. To convert raw bytes into larger units, divide by 1,000 for decimal kilobytes (KB) or 1,024 for binary kibibytes (KiB). One billion bytes equals 1 Gigabyte (GB) in decimal, or 0.931 Gibibytes (GiB) in binary.

faq.question: How many bits are in one byte?
faq.answer: There are exactly 8 bits in 1 byte. Each bit represents a binary zero (0) or one (1).

faq.question: How many bytes are in a Gigabyte?
faq.answer: In the decimal system, 1 GB equals 1,000,000,000 bytes (1 billion). In the binary system, 1 GiB equals 1,073,741,824 bytes.

faq.question: What is the difference between a kilobit (Kb) and a kilobyte (KB)?
faq.answer: A lowercase 'b' denotes bits, while an uppercase 'B' denotes bytes. 1 Kilobyte (KB) = 8 Kilobits (Kb).
